title: similar but not exactly
content: i have two dreams that were weird and similar but not exactly this...1st dream its a mall yes but instead of the other layouts its just a mall...grungy mall...like something you will see in the 90s its not wide but its tall infinite like no matter how many stairs i get there's another floor...it had gothic gates to keep us from falling over but it felt uncanny and unsettling i never been to this mall in real life i think i saw something similar obviously not infinite floors but similar to something i must of saw in a youtube video or something....and for the 2nd dream i'm in an amusement park alone and i'm looking for my mother because for some reason i am a child in this dream and i can't find her...i go around the empty park then stumble to colorful tube slides and i try to climb into them but always slide back down in my attempt...never able to get to the top...and after awhile i woke up...i think its just we have access to a lot of things our brain sees stuff stores them than mash them together and due to sharing over and over again people end up stabling around the same things and it stores into your psyche unknowingly and end up having similar dreams to others cause of that...but i do like the thought it might be something bigger than we can understand
